licenses.text:
Kinh Thánh, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/vie1934/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/vie1934/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in the Vietnamese language (1923)
> Public Domain
> Language: Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese)
> Translation by: William Cadman (1883-1948)
> Contributor: Christian and Missionary Alliance
> This free Bible is provided to you courtesy of eBible.org.
> NT first published 1923, OT first published 1925. The New Testament permanently and irrevocably entered the Public Domain on January 1, 2019 due to copyright expiration. The Old Testament entered the Public Domain on January 1, 2021. It was probably already in the Public Domain due to failure to comply with formalities earlier.
> 2022-06-09

What was found:
Text: the Vietnamese Bible of William Cadman (1883-1948), Grace Hazenberg Cadman (1876-1946), John Drange Olsen and Phan Khôi (1887-1959); New Testament 1923, Old Testament 1925-26, complete Bible 1934.

Why it stays out: missing fact: whether eBible's text matches the 1923 and 1925-26 printings or holds changes made for the 1934 edition, and John Drange Olsen's death year.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=vie1934), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/vie1934/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bible_translations_into_Vietnamese; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phan_Kh%C3%B4i.
